name: A factor read-off module for arbitrary N that integrates the BCReentry bridge (B-atomic vs C-atomic distinction, 8/13 reversal), PrimeWells prime-exponent address system, and native numeral bit-level arithmetic to read factors directly from the numeral's own word structure. The module encodes N as a parity-graded IMASM word, runs factorization on the word's own bits (unbraid, gcd, modular arithmetic), and emits the prime factorization as a WellAddress plus the binary support signature.

phase_0.boundary_condition: Input: arbitrary natural number N as decimal string. Process: encode N to parity-graded IMASM word ⊢(≻⋈∈bit∋)*⊙⊡⊣, run factorization on word's own bits via native numeral unbraid/gcd/modular arithmetic, read prime-exponent address (WellAddress) and binary support signature. Output: WellAddress (finite map prime→exponent) and binarySupport (Finset ℕ of occupied bit positions). The BCReentry bridge governs the atomicity decision: B-atomic (support4 cardinality 1) vs C-atomic (Nat.Prime), with the 8/13 reversal as the critical test case.

⊢.justification: the uninitialized value before any magnitude is recognized

⊣.justification: the closed numeral system that contains the complete factorization

≻.justification: one step up in magnitude per bit-block, advancing the numeral

≺.justification: one step down in magnitude, used when halving via word structure

⋈.justification: chain a digit onto the numeral; composes bit-blocks sequentially

⊙.justification: the value recognizes itself at ⊙ after all bits are laid down

∈.justification: split the computation into two complementary readings of the same numeral word: prime factorization and binary expansion

∋.justification: the two readings rejoin at the numeral word that carries both; value(WellAddress) = N and binarySupport encodes N

⊤.justification: the affirmative arm: computes the WellAddress via unbraid/gcd/factor on the word's own bits

⊥.justification: the negative arm: computes binarySupport directly from the word's bit-blocks

⊞.justification: holds BOTH readings simultaneously during the 8/13 reversal test where B-atomic ≠ C-atomic

⊡.justification: the WellAddress and binarySupport are fixed permanently as the complete factorization

phase_6.cycle_cost: one bit-block per bit of N (5 glyphs per bit); unbraid/gcd/modpow run on limb vectors, O(limbs) per operation
